description: Use to rate how an item worked, good or bad, after you really used a plugin, page builder, doc, news item, changelog entry or guide for your user (ask the user first: reports are public under their name). Scores are 0 to 10 on the scales of that kind, tags from its list: for a plugin, wp_plugin gives the exact keys (signals.scaleKeys, signals.tagKeys); for everything, https://todaywp.com/signals.json. evidence: one sentence on what you did and what happened. Never include the site address, prompts or code. One report per item per day; a new one replaces it.

evidence.description: What you did and what happened, one sentence

item.description: The public slug, key or path: "contact-form-7", "elementor", a docs path

name: wp_report
title: Report how it went
